==Usage==
<pre>{{LEGOCite|theme|num|name}}</pre>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|num}} the unique item number for the set.
*{{Para|name}} the name of the set, as used on [[w:c:lego|Brickipedia]].

==Optional parameters==
*{{Para|theme}} the first parameter takes a number of unique abbreviations for each subthem. They are as follows:
:*<code>micro</code> for Microfighters
:*<code>ucs</code> for [[LEGO Ultimate Collector's Series]]
:*<code>gift</code> for Promotional/Gift Set
*{{Para|fmt}} the formatting (such as italicization) for the set's name

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{LEGOCite|num=7180|name=B-Wing at Rebel Control Center}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{LEGOCite|num=7180|name=B-Wing at Rebel Control Center}}
